_comment: WRITTEN BY THE RELEASE JOB, never by hand. 10-WEBSITE §5: a stale checksum on a security product is worse than none, so /download renders this file and the release workflow overwrites it on tag. The zero hashes below are the shape a hash has, not a hash — scripts/gates.mjs fails the build if a page renders one while release.state is "published", which is what stops a placeholder reaching a live download page.

artifacts.label: Windows
artifacts.confinement: AppContainer + restricted token + Job Object, no network capability SID
artifacts.note: Recommended. Asks where to install and whether to install for you alone or for every user of the machine.
